title: The realm's actual size vastly outstrips the 450-turn budget if you engage with the game's own invitation to 'talk to people twice, carry what they give you, choose and live with it': just the Vale of Ash (Act 1) plus companion recruitment took ~165 turns, and each subsequent hold (Thornwold, Iron Downs, Saltkerns) cost another 70-100+ turns even without finishing every side thread. By turn 449 I had rested only 2 of 6 hollows (though I'd separately earned the Regent's writ through honest Watch service) and never reached Coldpass or Marrowgate, despite steady, purposeful play throughout.
